The decisive mistake was WebSurfer's answer at step 16. It had only run a search and never opened a lyrics page, yet it reported "bite" as the last word before the second chorus. "Human Nature" is the correct fifth single from *Thriller*, but the actual last word before its second chorus is "stare" ("She likes the way I stare"). The orchestrator then accepted the unverified answer.

AGENT: WebSurfer
STEP: 16
